original_test_intent: Verify every required NVSM-managed device appears in the live system-health view and reports the approved healthy state with no missing or unknown subsystems.
original_method: Pin approved NVSM build; preserve diagnostics; inventory expected managed device hierarchy; run exact `nvsm show health` read-only; retain raw subsystem/device/status/health/detail fields; compare completeness and semantic health mapping against the platform manifest; correlate nonhealthy/unknown entries without remediation.
manual_activity: Platform owner supplies expected managed-device inventory and health semantics and dispositions every nonhealthy or unknown entry.
required_inputs: Status_Health/detail semantics and accepted state aliases
safety_requirements: Never clear logs, acknowledge alerts or remediate devices
Prove inventory completeness before accepting overall Healthy
agent_execution_scope: Compare completeness and every device health state
engineer_actions: Resolve all nonhealthy or missing entries

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The query is applicable but cannot prove all devices are healthy without an expected inventory and health schema.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the literal command and compare every expected identity and state while retaining raw hierarchy.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Overall system health and every-device coverage are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Create a required-device matrix with observed path, status, health, details and diagnostic disposition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Prevents a top-level summary from hiding missing devices.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Alert absence or readable output cannot prove inventory-complete health.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: NVSM can roll child state into a summary differently by release; raw child records must be retained.

project_override_considerations: Project owner defines required managed devices, optional nodes and accepted health aliases for the deployed NVSM version.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Procedure and Criteria consistently require overall/all-device health; missing inventory/schema are project inputs and log clearing is rejected for evidence safety.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Package and health manifest are provisionable; live query is read-only.

review_improvement: Requires complete child-device coverage rather than trusting a single overall Healthy label.
independent_technical_reasoning: A management summary can remain healthy while an unsupported or absent device is omitted from its tree. Acceptance therefore requires set equality against the expected inventory plus per-node health, not merely a top-level string match.
